Let's start the chat on #Selfcare and why #blacklivesmatter 

I am going to share some nuggets from my piece @theGrio and although I wrote this piece with black people in mind, the self-care tips apply to all of us as human beings.
After a year of trauma, self-care must be a priority for Black people in 2021. #selfcare #BlackLivesMatter #mentalhealth https://t.co/n7vxDHKmWJ

Life is 100% about the choices that we make. And most of the time, we as Black people make choices out of necessity, out of obligation, and regrettably out of desperation. 

If we want a better way forward in 2021, our decision making needs to change. #BlackLivesMatter 1/
No longer being dragged along by our circumstances, our fears, and our lack. It’s time to shift into a New Year, with a new attitude. #BlackLivesMatter #Selfcare 3/

We need to start putting self-care first. And we need to stop accepting what life throws at us and make a decision to take life by the hand and drag it along to where we want to go. #BlackLivesMatter #Selfcaer #Mentalhealth 2/
